description_en: Modifies a scaling plan for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-elastic-plan --elastic-plan-name test --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html operation to query the names of scaling plans
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html接口可以查看指定集群的弹性计划名称
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the scaling plan.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the scaling plan.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: A CORN expression that specifies the scaling cycle and time for the scaling plan
parameters.help_zh: Cron表达式，表示弹性计划的变配周期和变配时间
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.help_en:
The desired specifications of elastic resources after scaling.



If the scaling plan uses EIUs and Default Proportional Scaling for EIUs is enabled, you do not need to specify this parameter. In other cases, you must specify this parameter.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601278.html operation to query the specifications that are supported for scaling plans
parameters.help_zh:
目标规格。
只有弹性资源类型为存储加速服务弹性计划并且启用了存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性，可以不填写该参数。其它情况下，该参数为必填项。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601278.html接口可以查看弹性计划支持的弹性变配规格
parameters.name: target_size

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看目标地域下集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id
